summary: First-ever pre-market report. Stable weekly expiry closed at day high; banks weak, Reliance stuck near 1,900 while non-heavyweights (Hero MotoCorp, Tata Steel) led. Covid >4 lakh cases/day the only headwind. US jobs data due; Fed valuation warning.

events.claim: Hero MotoCorp rose 4% on good results (May 6-7, 2021)
US weekly jobless claims better than expected; Nasdaq turned positive after four down days
Fed warned asset classes are richly valued and could correct significantly
US considering waiver of vaccine intellectual-property rights

lessons: In bull markets all negatives are ignored; in bear markets all positives are ignored.
Good news is good news, very good news is bad news - the surprise coefficient moves markets.
quote: 14,000 will be the strong support for the Nifty on a monthly basis.
leaks: 'first pre market report... more than 55,000 views'

summary: Gap-up faded but HDFC results (+3%) turned an expected black Friday green. Tata Steel ran 500 to ~1,200 in a month. India VIX crashed over 5%. US April jobs shocked at 2.66 lakh vs 1 million expected; Dow fell but Nasdaq rose; yields down.

events.claim: US April 2021 nonfarm payrolls came at 266,000 vs ~1 million expected (May 7, 2021)
Tata Steel rallied from ~500 to nearly 1,200 within a month (Apr-May 2021)
HDFC Ltd results lifted the stock ~3% on May 7, 2021
US 10-year yield fell to 1.55% after the jobs miss

lessons: Retail buys bad news sectors (oxygen, masks, pharma) hoping to capitalize - the crowd chases the theme.
Buy-your-own-shares story: retail picking stocks alone buys the bad apples; expert filtering at least halves mistakes.
quote: Everybody was expecting black Friday. But instead of black Friday the HDFC result made it as green Friday.
dup_flag: pre/post pair with 0343; jobs-expectation narrative repeated in 0348
leaks: 'expert speaker in a television channel called Sun TV'

summary: Bad US jobs data eased rate-hike fears - 'only crying babies get the chocolate' - US at record highs. GST at 1.41 lakh crore. SGX hit 15,000. SBI Life 4,000-crore block deal distorted FII/DII data: ex-deal, FIIs were buyers. Banks must join for a new ATH.

events.claim: SBI Life saw a ~4,000 crore block deal on May 7, 2021 (FII seller; ~2,500 crore absorbed by DIIs)
India GST collection reached 1.41 lakh crore, up ~40% from sub-1-lakh-crore months (April 2021 collection)
Janet Yellen indicated the Fed may slowly raise interest rates (early May 2021)

lessons: Headline FII/DII figures can be distorted by block deals - adjust before reading the flow.
For the index to make new highs, its biggest underperforming sector must participate.
quote: Though FIIs figure shows more than 1000 crore selling, if you exclude the SBI life data, they have actually bought.

summary: 150-point Monday gap-up; stable trade let India VIX fall 3% to ~20.22 - only the 2nd-3rd close below 20 in 2021. FII futures balanced 50/50. Metals index doubled in six months. ITM 15,000 put OI build flagged as bullish. 14,900 straddle ~180 implies 14,700-15,100.

events.claim: Nifty metal index more than doubled in ~6 months (from ~2,000 to 5,000+)
India VIX closed at ~20.22, one of only 2-3 sub-20 closes in 2021 so far

lessons: Balanced FII positioning and falling VIX mark a stable regime that favours option sellers.
A rise in open interest on in-the-money puts is a rare bullish tell.
quote: Smart people are selling 14,900 straddle... roughly the market can make a move of around 200 points.

summary: Nasdaq -2% on tech-to-non-tech rotation; WHO classified the Indian triple-mutant variant as a global health risk, adding a double whammy. SGX signalled a 200-point gap-down a day before expiry - 14,900 put sellers at 80-90 were at risk below 14,800. Midcaps had hit an ATH.

events.claim: WHO classified the Indian triple-mutant Covid variant (B.1.617) as a global health risk (May 10-11, 2021)
Midcap index hit an all-time high on May 10, 2021

lessons: A pre-expiry gap-down traps put sellers below their breakeven and can cascade into more shorting.
Once VIX lives near 20, sub-20 reads are the new 'low' - recalibrate regime thresholds.

summary: Opened better than feared and recovered ~150 points; Bank Nifty +500-600 off lows; mid/small caps green while indices red. VIX closed below 20 for only the third 2021 session. Top five Nifty gainers were PSU banks. Both FIIs (-336cr) and DIIs sold ~1,000cr - 'who bought it?'

events.claim: On May 11, 2021 both FIIs and DIIs sold cash equities while indices closed mixed - unusual absorption

lessons: Option sellers must stay dynamic - roll the straddle to the new centre as the market drifts.
Be neither bull nor bear; be a chameleon - adapt positioning to the environment.
quote: You neither be a bull nor be a bear, but you always have to be a chameleon.

summary: Dow -400 on rate-hike jitters ahead of US CPI. Three global headwinds framework: Covid, rate hikes, US corporate tax hike. Recalls Feb-2018: a hot inflation print and Dow 'fell 10% in one day'. Midcap index at fresh ATH; expiry-day volatility plus US CPI in the last hour.

events.claim: In Feb 2018, after a higher-than-expected US inflation print, the Dow fell ~10% in one day (5% in hours, 5% after)
US April 2021 CPI was due May 12, 2021
MSCI rejig caused stock-specific action on May 12, 2021

lessons: Higher inflation -> higher rates -> money moves from equity to debt: the chain that makes CPI a market event.
Expiry-day plus a macro release in the last hour is a recipe for violent two-sided moves.
quote: There are three headwinds for the stock markets: the coronavirus, the interest rate hike, and the corporate tax rate hike in the US.

summary: ~300-point high-to-low fall on US CPI fear; US April CPI printed 4.2%, highest in ~13 years. He closed all positions into the Friday holiday. India data was strong: CPI 4.29%, IIP +22.4%, GST 1.4 lakh crore - regime flipped to good local cues, bad global cues. Three-month range 14,200-15,400.

events.claim: US April 2021 CPI printed 4.2%, the highest in about 13 years (May 12, 2021)
India April 2021 CPI at 4.29%, inside the RBI 2-6% band
India April 2021 IIP grew 22.4% year-on-year (base effect)

lessons: Go flat into a binary macro event when the tail risk is a 10%-type session - losing 5-10 points of edge is cheap insurance.
Rangebound markets reward monthly short straddles; trend traders starve, sellers eat.
quote: Higher the inflation, higher will be the interest rate... money will be moving from equity to debt.
leaks: 'I will come out with a full video'

summary: FII+DII sold ~3,000 crore over two days; FII index-futures long collapsed 70% to 40%. He exited all positions pre-CPI - the lose-5-to-save-200 asymmetry. Crowd uniformly bearish; 'markets bottom when the last bull turns bear'. PSU pack with dividend yields defied the fall. Support 14,580, resistance 14,780.

events.claim: FII long position in index futures fell from ~70% to ~40% within May 2021
FII and DII combined cash-market selling topped ~3,000 crore across May 12-13, 2021

lessons: When everyone - cash, futures, options - is bearish, the market is often nearer a bottom than a breakdown.
Accept small certain losses (5-10 points) to avoid large uncertain ones; sleep is a position too.
quote: A market tops out when the last bear turns bull; the markets bottom out when the last bull turns into bear.
leaks: 'I am a research analyst, I have passed that examination but not SEBI registered'

summary: Feared Monday crash never came: Nifty closed just 15-20 points down as US recovered. All sectoral indices red except FMCG; ITC +5%, Asian Paint and UPL +7-8% on results; Reliance stayed positive. PSU banks and metals saw routine profit booking. House-tour video announced.

events.claim: ITC rose ~5% and Asian Paint/UPL rose ~7-8% on results (May 14, 2021)

lessons: Profit booking in a crowded momentum pack (PSU banks, metals) is consolidation, not reversal.
Gap-down fears priced over a holiday often dissipate - position for the reopen, not the panic.

summary: Against weak Asian cues (China PMI miss) India rallied one-way: top five Nifty gainers all banks (IndusInd +8%, SBI +5-6%), Bank index +4%. The FII-short squeeze thesis worked: 60% short positioning cushioned falls and fuelled the rip. VIX broke below 20 decisively (~19.6). Corona cases down to ~3 lakh/day.

events.claim: IndusInd Bank +~8% and SBI +5-6% on May 17, 2021; all top-5 Nifty gainers were banks
Bank Nifty rose >4% in a short-covering rally on May 17, 2021

lessons: When a majority (60%+) is short, falls are cushioned by profit-taking and rallies are amplified by stop-loss buying - the asymmetry behind the FII-positioning indicator.
Short-covering rallies can run against negative global cues; flows trump headlines.
quote: If 60% of the people are short... for one or the other reason market shoots up, they scramble to buy, so market goes up.

summary: Bank Nifty +1,300 Monday; still 10-15% below ATH vs Nifty 3-4% below. Corona down to 2.6 lakh/day. FIIs only 46% long - trapped shorts face a 180-point SGX gap-up. Japan Q1 GDP -5.1% yet Japan higher. Rule: short only when FII long >75%, never below 50%. 15,000 turns support; resistance 15,180.

events.claim: Japan Q1 2021 GDP contracted 5.1% (annualised), below expectations
Bank Nifty rallied ~1,300 points on May 17, 2021

lessons: A long-held resistance taken out with a gap becomes the next support - flip the level, flip the trade.
Never initiate shorts when FII longs are below 50%; the crowd is already positioned for your squeeze.
quote: I will never think of shorting the market when the FII long position is less than 50%.

summary: Gap-up above 15,050 - the two-month ceiling - sustained all day, defying the 90% fade rule. FIIs and DIIs both net buyers; Nifty +1,000 off the lows. ATH expected within 6-8 weeks. NBFCs (Bajaj twins, Sriram) led. 15,100 straddle ~200 implies 14,900-15,300. 14,000 put sold monthly since March.

events.claim: Nifty sustained a gap-up above the 15,050 two-month high on May 18, 2021
FII and DII both turned net cash buyers on May 18, 2021

lessons: When a huge gap-up after a big rally is NOT sold into, that resilience itself is the bullish confirmation.
DIIs tend to fade FII flows - they buy FII weakness and sell FII strength; net flows must be read jointly.
quote: Usually people like to go long when the resistance are taken out... market will close somewhere near the resistance, the next day there will be a huge gap up.

summary: US fell in the second half ahead of Fed minutes; India may decouple as corona falls (2.6 lakh/day) and both FII (+618cr) and DII (+450cr) bought. FII futures long 40%->60% via covering. Autos strong on monsoon + reopening demand. HDFC Bank +2.63% locally vs +3.25% in its US ADR - the premium read. Support 15,020; range 15,020-15,220.

events.claim: US Fed minutes released May 19, 2021 (markets jittery pre-release)
HDFC Bank rose 2.63% in India while its US ADR rose 3.25% the prior night

lessons: ADR premium/discount is a same-asset sentiment read-through for the local open.
After FIIs turn buyers, DIIs historically fade them the next day - expect the baton to pass.
quote: If you are walking very fast for half an hour, you may have to rest - the Nifty has run up too sharply.

summary: Mild gap-down, weak tape; Singapore GRM improvement lifted Reliance. China's crypto restrictions crashed coins 30-40%; BTC swung $34,000->32,000->34,500 within minutes - cross-asset deleveraging fears hit equities. Nasdaq -5% in May. Booked 15,100 straddle, rolled to 15,000. Warned of fake-ID crypto scams and fake broker calls.

events.claim: China announced cryptocurrency restrictions; many cryptos fell 30-40% (May 19, 2021)
Bitcoin swung from ~$34,000 to ~$32,000 and back to ~$34,500 within minutes on May 19, 2021
Nasdaq fell more than 5% during May 2021 (month-to-date)

lessons: Unmanageable losses in one asset class spill into others as leveraged traders liquidate winners - crypto stress is equity stress.
Huge call writing above a strike marks the market's perceived ceiling into expiry.
quote: When there are unmanageable positions in one asset class, it will affect other asset classes also.
leaks: 'people create fake ID in my name in YouTube'
'calling from Mr. P R Sundar's office'
'I have a tie-up only with fivepaisa.com'

summary: Fed minutes signalled possible taper talk as the economy strengthens; BTC's 44k->30k->40k day (a 7-10 lakh rupee intraday range) broke SGX below 15,000 overnight. FIIs sold 10 of 11 sessions. India positives: IIP, GST, early monsoon, fertilizer subsidy for the rural theme. IOC GRM surprise: $12.5 vs usual $2-3.

events.claim: Fed minutes (May 19, 2021) indicated future discussions of tapering asset purchases
Bitcoin ranged $44,000-$30,000-$40,000 within a single day (May 19, 2021)
Indian Oil declared a gross refining margin of $12.5/bbl vs a usual $2-3
Government increased fertilizer subsidy (May 2021)

lessons: News has no fixed value - the same fact is bullish or bearish depending on the regime's interpretation.
When local fundamentals improve while global cues sour, expect a divergent, India-specific trend.
quote: News by itself has no value. It is how people interpret.
leaks: 'these are all my personal views... I have right to be wrong'

summary: Second consolidation day: private banks (HDFC, Kotak, ICICI) dragged while SBI stayed green pre-results; PSU bank index +0.36%. China steel curbs knocked steel 5-6% after a doubling run. The last-90-minute slide was expiry positioning, not reversal - his 15,000 straddle closed profitable. US jobless claims lowest post-pandemic.

events.claim: China moved to restrict steel prices; steel stocks fell 5-6% (May 20, 2021)
US weekly jobless claims fell to the lowest level since the pandemic began (week of May 15, 2021)

lessons: Late selloffs on expiry day reflect position squaring, not new information - don't read trend into them.
Expiry-day flow data is noisy; discount institutional numbers printed that day.
quote: We can see anything that happens in the last 1-2 hour on expiry day - that is because of positions, expiry day related issues.

summary: US VIX fell ~7% toward 20 - the jitter premium is deflating. Nifty broke 14,980 late yesterday, breaching 14,900: his sold 14,900 puts (sold 15-20, at 1-2) were stopped at 10, then the option went to zero - an expiry trap for big put sellers. SBI results today historically flip bearish bank tapes. 15,000 straddle ~300 implies 14,700-15,300.

events.claim: CBOE VIX fell ~7% on May 19-20, 2021, back near 20
SBI Q4 results were scheduled for May 21, 2021 during market hours

lessons: Even a premium decayed to 1-2 rupees deserves a stop-loss: the last 10 rupees of a trap can cost more than the whole credit.
Expiry-day operators push price toward large option positions to trap sellers - expect it, size for it.
quote: Sometimes people... try for some short selling in order to trap those people. I have been trapped many times.
leaks: 'I sold a huge amount of 14,900 put option'

summary: SBI results flipped the tape: Bank Nifty short-covering drove Nifty to its second-highest close ever (>15,175) and India VIX to its 2021 low (~19). Week: +430/+2,000 then -200/-600, then full Friday recovery. Corona bears targeting 12,000/10,000 dismissed. Serial put-buyer story - no stop-loss, capital gone. Personal: >2 crore profit in one account, 50 lakh donated.

events.claim: SBI Q4 FY21 results (May 21, 2021) turned the banking tape; Bank Nifty saw huge short covering
Nifty logged its second-highest close in history on May 21, 2021 (ATH close then ~15,245)
India VIX closed at its 2021 low (~19) on May 21, 2021

lessons: The economy walks, the market is the dog on the leash - they correlate loosely and the leash matters more day to day.
Option buying demands far more skill than selling; adding puts as the market rises without a stop-loss destroys capital.
A bearish consensus in a bull regime (crash targets during Covid wave 2) is itself the contrarian signal.
quote: Forget about 10,000 and 9,000 - the Nifty will not even test the last year high of 12,400.
leaks: 'I made more than 2 crore profit in just one account and I donated 50 lakhs'

summary: Post-SBI-rally digestion: futures at ~50-point premium, range shifts up to 15,000-15,500. Consensus broker targets (600-700 on SBI) flagged as dangerous. Full SBI options structure taught: buy 390CE, sell 2x420CE, buy 460CE, sell 360PE, buy 320PE - net credit 1,200, margin ~1.06 lakh, max profit 44,000 at 420, max loss 58,000, breakevens 360-450. Marriage-adjustment analogy for strategy repair.

events.claim: Brokerages published SBI targets of 600-700 after Q4 results (May 22-24, 2021)
CNBC displayed a wrong NPA figure during SBI results, causing a 4-5% flash drop before recovery

lessons: Consensus is dangerous: when everyone agrees on a target, the surprise bar sits above it.
Design credit structures where breakevens sit 10-12% away - the position survives being wrong directionally.
Analysis picks the trade; adjustment is the real edge - plan the repair before the entry.
quote: You cannot get the best girl for your marriage, but after the marriage you can always adjust. Same way with strategies.
leaks: 'I am not a SEBI registered analyst'
'Mr. Sundar does not believe in giving money to other people'

summary: SBI opened +3-4% (first tick 420) powering Bank Nifty +336 while Nifty +20; broader indices outperformed. Bank Nifty's last hour whipsawed 800 up (2:30-3:00) then 800 down (3:00-3:30) - a 1,600-point swing. OI validated the shift: 15,000PE max OI, sold 15,200PE/15,300CE = +/-200 around 15,200. Peak-margin rules did not hurt his P&L. BSE webinar announced.

events.claim: Bank Nifty swung ~1,600 points intra-hour on May 24, 2021 (+800 in 2:30-3:00, -800 in 3:00-3:30)
FII bought 585 crore while DII sold 707 crore on May 24, 2021
SEBI peak-margin rules did not reduce his trading profitability (claimed)

lessons: Max-OI strikes define the market's expected range - selling beyond them (15,200PE/15,300CE) prices a ±200 consolidation.
Expiry-week last-hour whipsaws are position mechanics; non-directional traders should expect them, not fear them.
quote: The 15,000 put option has the highest open interest... that validates my view that the trading range shifted to 15,000-15,500.
leaks: 'I will be doing a webinar sponsored by Bombay Stock Exchange'

summary: SGX ~15,300, 1% from ATH despite Reliance -20% and HDFC Bank under an RBI credit-card ban - proof the only headwind was corona (now <2 lakh cases/day vs 4 lakh). Dow red 4 of 5 weeks on rate jitters but US VIX back under 19. FII long 60% index / 53% stock: room to run before the 75-80% crowding ceiling. 15,000 the strong support.

events.claim: RBI restrictions barred HDFC Bank from issuing new credit cards (Dec 2020 order, still in force May 2021)
India reported under 2 lakh daily new Covid cases on May 25, 2021, down from 4+ lakh
Dow closed lower in 4 of the last 5 weeks on interest-rate jitters

lessons: When the index nears highs while its top weights languish, the rally is broad and the drag is your margin of safety.
FII long ratio is a crowding meter: 50-60% leaves upside room; 75-80% means profit-taking risk dominates.
quote: The stock which has the highest weightage is trading 20% lower and still we are at striking distance from all-time high.

summary: Gap-up sold exactly at 15,300; a Macquarie-arranged HDFC Bank investor meet disappointed and Bank Nifty -280 (entirely HDFC Bank). Nifty still +10 - without the two lagging heavyweights it would have closed at a record. Closed ~15,210, 35 points off the ATH close. Bank Nifty whipsawed -800/+400 late; 15,200 straddle profited; 35,000 the Bank Nifty pivot.

events.claim: HDFC Bank fell after a Macquarie-arranged investor meeting disappointed (May 25, 2021)
Bank Nifty's decline (-280) came entirely from HDFC Bank on May 25, 2021

lessons: Weight arithmetic matters: Bank Nifty is ~1/3 of Nifty, so a 280-point Bank Nifty drag costs the index ~90 points.
Into record highs, dip-buyers at support and profit-bookers at resistance coexist - expect rotation, not trend.
quote: HDFC Bank and Reliance, if these two stocks were not there, then today we would have closed at all-time high.

summary: SGX -30/40 on futures premium (~30) after a last-half-hour short-covering pop; he distrusts it. FII long jumped to 62%; RSI 60-62 - overbought begins near 80, so technically not stretched. Gap-ups invite profit booking. Bank Nifty range 34,400-35,000 on max OI. Results: 'PPCL' (PFC?), Manappuram, Berger Paints. Needs HDFC Bank + Reliance for the ATH. Free webinar announced.

events.claim: FII long position in index futures rose to ~62% (May 2021)

lessons: RSI ~60-62 is not overbought; reserve that call for ~80 - otherwise you exit trends too early.
A late short-covering pop in futures premium distorts overnight signals - fade the mechanical, not the fundamental.
quote: The markets are considered to be overbought only when RSI reaches about 80.
leaks: 'planning to a webinar... free webinar' promo

summary: Steady climb to the third-highest close (>15,200); a viewer corrected his ATH-close figure from 15,245 to 15,315 - today briefly crossed it. Rally is broad-based: midcaps already at record while Reliance (+3) and HDFC Bank (red) lag. Straddle ladder rolled 15,000->15,100->15,200->15,300. FII +242cr, DII -439cr on thin participation (possible bank holiday). 'Sell in May' failed. Technical-analysis jab at an 8,960-target tweet.

events.claim: Nifty's all-time closing high was 15,315, not 15,245 (speaker correction on May 26, 2021)
Midcap index was already above its all-time high while Nifty was ~15 points from a record close (May 26, 2021)
A market participant tweeted a Nifty target of 8,960 on April 21, 2021

lessons: Roll the straddle up as the market climbs - non-directional income is a management process, not a set-and-forget trade.
Do not expect the market to dance to your tune; you must dance to the market's tune.
Verify your own reference numbers (ATH closes) - being corrected publicly is cheaper than compounding an error.
quote: Do not expect the market to dance to your own tune; you have to dance to the market's tune.
